name: Singapore

evidence.claim: Weighs cabin bags at check-in — 7 kg, and they do enforce it.

allowances.note: Additional small bag. Main cabin bag IS permitted, but its per-axis dimensions are not published.

Singapore publishes no per-axis box for the cabin bag — the rule is the sum of the three sides. Held in published_cabin_allowances until the engine supported linear-only constraints; moved into allowances 2026-08-31.

research_scope: Standard adult cabin/personal allowances; checked allowances remain unresearched unless a sourced checked row is present.
audit_note: Read cabin table and additional-items section. Economy: 1 piece, 7 kg, sum of dimensions <=115 cm; no per-axis box published. Removed unsupported 55x40x20 placeholder. Linear rule moved into allowances 2026-08-31, once the engine honoured linear-only cabin constraints. Shared-weight groups, linear constraints, aircraft and entitlement exceptions require further engine/publication review. Strictness and sizer measurements were not verified in this audit.
